import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Slug de un título. Ver README."""
    norm = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode().lower()
    words = [w for w in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9]+", norm) if w]
    out = ""
    for w in words:
        cand = f"{out}-{w}" if out else w
        if len(cand) > 60:
            break
        out = cand
    return out
